root_causes.cause: Latency-only degradation: every gRPC call to it costs ~300 ms (pod Ready, 0 restarts, no errors, probes pass at 1s timeout). Page latency scales with call count: home 1 call = 0.32s, product page 6 calls + 1 inside recommendationservice = ~2.1s, cart page 5+items = 1.8-3.2s (each cart item adds ~250-345ms), checkout ~5 calls = 2.4s; endpoints making no productcatalog call (/setCurrency 0ms) stay fast. Mechanism most consistent with a fixed network delay on that pod's veth (~300ms/call, near-zero variance) rather than CPU throttling, but tc qdisc could not be read (no node/exec access).

root_causes.object: cartservice / redis-cart write path (low confidence, secondary)
root_causes.cause: POST /cart performs a single cartservice call and no productcatalog call yet still takes 281-324 ms, while one correlation of a GET /cart shows the cart read hop at only ~25 ms; a second, smaller ~300 ms contributor on the add-to-cart path cannot be excluded and could not be confirmed with the available read-only, non-exec evidence.
